author: Arnav
problem: pantry maps each ingredient to how many grams a bakery has, and recipe maps each ingredient to the grams one batch of the recipe needs. Return how many whole batches the bakery can make.
bug_description: Returns max of the per-ingredient batch counts instead of min, so it ignores the ingredient that runs out first.

comments.accurate: Number of complete batches the pantry has enough of every ingredient for
comments.wrong_behavior: Number of batches the pantry supports, going by its best-stocked ingredient
comments.wrong_location: Per-ingredient count verified; ingredients missing from the pantry may need to be skipped
